required_fixes: C5 heterogeneity MUST be endpoint-stratified per spec/freeze decision_rule: recompute as |r_stratified_enabled - r_stratified_disabled| < 2*SE_pooled. Producer used simple pooled r_enabled=-0.4848 r_disabled=0.0123 diff=0.4971 (FAIL) while audit recomputed stratified r_enabled=-0.0239 r_disabled=0.0230 diff=0.0469 < 0.0766 (PASS). Run_experiment.py lines 889-912 pools by concatenating across endpoints without stratification - fix by weighting per-endpoint r by n as done for C3/C4.

V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE fix incomplete for /api/session/status: stable_key = f'session_{session_id}' (testbed_server.py:385-386) is per-session not per permission_level, so valid vs expired write ETags never overlap (overlap_count 0, fix_verified false per result.json:etag_permission_verification). Spec requres derive permission_level from session independent of token expiry and verify overlap for write-permission conditions - either make session_status ETag depend on permission_level or exclude it from verification and document that session_status is structurally isolated by session_id.

C7 negative control (B-PARENT-CONFOUND-REPRODUCTION) threshold |r|>=0.15 fails at |r|=0.1228 (CI [-0.189,-0.054], n=816) - does not confirm V1 confound was genuine under header-only extraction. Per-endpoint B-PARENT r shows strong effect on profile (-0.359, p=1e-09) and data_list (-0.415, p=9e-13) but null on session_status (-0.006). Pooled is diluted. Stratified pooled (|r|=0.260) would PASS. Clarify frozen C7 definition (simple pooled vs stratified) and either increase bifurcation strength on session_status or bound negative control to profile/data_list only.

V3 selection bias persists in raw cache-enabled valid composition: valid cache-enabled non-304 is 68/72 (94% session_status, 2 profile +2 data_list +68 session_status) due to 33/34 304 rate for profile/data_list (result.json n_304_total 132, all valid). Stratified pooling corrects pooled (C3/C4) but per-cache simple pooling does not. Document or rebalance sampling (equal non-304 per endpoint) or always stratify per-cache.

Measurement representation ceiling: headers-only structural signal (ETag change 0/1, Cache-Control change 0/1, request_id entropy, SHA256 hash) is intentionally narrow. Claim must remain bounded to header-only on single-node Flask localhost (127.0.0.1:18970) with in-memory CDN - not distributed CDN, concurrent load, or body-inclusive signals.

baseline_findings.finding: Historical baseline confirmed and not re-measured here. Four independent n=480 mocks reported |r| 0.0022-0.046 PASS at delta 0.15 (EXP-GRAPH-35389145821, 35353011131, etc). This experiment does not contradict them; stratified r 0.0125 is consistent.

Strong positive control for infrastructure independence. Recomputed simple pooled r=0.02097 matches producer 0.02097, CI [-0.047,0.089], TOST pass, behavioral_std 3.5, per-endpoint r profile -0.020 data_list 0.146 session 0.034. Confirms orthogonality persists without CDN/OAuth/dynamic content, isolating infrastructure as not causal.

Negative control FAILS to reproduce |r|>=0.15 at pooled level (|r|=0.1228 n=816 FAIL) despite stronger n. However per-endpoint shows strong confound on profile/data_list (-0.359/-0.415, p<1e-9) but null on session_status (-0.006). Demonstrates V1 entropy bifurcation (token_hex vs uuid4) *is* detectable header-only, but not uniformly. Producer's header-only extraction dilutes effect vs body-inclusive prior (r=0.375 in EXP-GRAPH-35445595108). Outcome triggers frozen C7 FAIL -> frozen REJECTED, but not evidence that V1 was not genuine.

claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 SURVIVES only as within-endpoint, endpoint-stratified, header-only, non-304 effect on a single-node Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 RS256 + SQLite WAL + in-memory CDN simulation (ETag-SHA256, max-age/no-store) localhost testbed: stratified r=0.0125 (n=684, 95% CI [-0.062,0.087], TOST p_upper 0.00015 <0.05), per-endpoint r profile -0.023 data_list -0.001 session 0.049, replicated B-FLASK-ONLY |r|=0.021 (n=816). Frozen decision rule as written yields REJECTED (MIXED) because C7 negative control |r|=0.123 <0.15 FAILS and C5 was measured with wrong (simple) pooling - correctly stratified C5 PASSES (diff 0.047 <0.076). Maximum justified: parallel-channel architecture NOT justified for product deployment on production infrastructure; remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to localhost production-like mock. No evidence for distributed CDN, concurrent load, body-inclusive signals, or delta=0.10.

unresolved: Whether C7 should be defined as stratified pooled (|r| 0.26 PASS) or simple pooled (|r| 0.123 FAIL) - frozen spec says simple pooled for C7, but endpoint heterogeneity (session_status null) dilutes pooled and suggests endpoint-specific negative control is needed.
Whether session_status ETag should be permission-dependent or is correctly isolated by session_id - affects structural heterogeneity interpretation and V_ETAG verification scope.
Whether CDN cache invalidation on session state change introduces correlation under real distributed multi-node cache vs single-node in-memory cache - testbed cannot express.
Whether concurrent client load or cache hierarchies change correlation structure at production scale.
Whether header-only structural signal is sufficient for product freshness detection vs body-inclusive SHA256 body hash (prior body-inclusive r 0.375).
Whether per-cache heterogeneity is sampling noise (stratified diff 0.047 suggests noise) or would emerge as systematic at larger n or with body signals.
Generalization beyond Flask/PyJWT/RS256/localhost to other frameworks and production CDN/OIDC.
